one_sentence_story: Years of vibrate alerts train your brain's habit loop and touch map so hard that a tiny pant-leg rustle gets misread as a real phone buzz.
so_what_for_you: Your leg nerves are completely fine. Turn vibrate mode off or move your phone into a bag for two days and the fake buzzes fade.

jargon_map.plain: your brain's strong expectations before senses arrive
jargon_map.analogy: autocorrect guessing a word before you finish typing
a security board watching every inch of your clothes
muscle memory reaching for your pocket before you think

jargon_map.plain: staying on edge waiting for an alert
jargon_map.analogy: listening for a doorbell so hard the wind sounds like a chime
